findings.failureScenario: favoriteThemes uses a deserializer that errors on any id not in ThemeKind::ALL. That error fails deserialization of the whole UiState in decode_saved_ui, which only has a compatibility recovery for `docking`; load_prefs_at then treats ui.json as damaged, renames it aside and starts with defaults, so library_path, recent libraries and the user keymap are lost for the session. A ui.json written by a build with an additional/renamed theme (downgrade, or a theme rename) triggers this from one favourite star. (Load path: apps/lightcraft/src/main.rs:226-277, decode_saved_ui / load_prefs_at.)
findings.action: In the persisted-settings path, drop unknown/duplicate favourite ids (filter) instead of failing, or extend decode_saved_ui's field-level recovery to favoriteThemes as it does for docking; keep strict validation for control-channel writes if desired.

anchor.text: return Err(serde::de::Error::custom("unknown or duplicate favorite theme"));
